pages.text: $(italic)Formerly living; undead mechanics apply. The pack's most punishing race in daylight and its most powerful at night.$()$(br2)$(bold)Dark Power$(): +20% damage dealt between 8pm and 4am (in-game time), stacking with class bonuses.$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$(): permanent. By day you see just as a Human does.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Sunlight Weakness$(): direct sunlight burns you like a zombie. Helmets and shade prevent this, so plan around it.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Penalty$(): natural regen and most healing potions are 30% less effective. Life Steal and Paladin auras are unaffected.$(br2)$(bold)Next: keep a helmet on from your first day.$()
